<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*Three [[Sudan]]ese migrants are killed and four others injured after [[Libya]]n authorities opened fire against them during landing operations in the city of [[Al-Khums]]. [https://www.repubblica.it/cronaca/2020/07/28/news/due_migranti_riportati_in_libia_e_uccisi-263078347/ (''La Repubblica'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*A 63-year-old woman is killed in a [[great white shark]] attack near [[Bailey Island (Maine)|Bailey Island]], off the coast of [[Maine]], [[United States]]. It is the first ever fatal [[shark attack]] on record in Maine, and only the second attack ever recorded in the state. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-53572785 (BBC News)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Vietnam]]
****[[Vietnam]] confirms 18 new cases, the highest number of local transmitted cases in 24 hours since March. [https://ncov.moh.gov.vn/dong-thoi-gian (Vietnamese Health Ministry)]
****Vietnam suspends all flights to and from [[Da Nang]] and closes its airport for 15 days after 14 COVID-19 cases are confirmed in that city. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/1958787/vietnam-closes-danang-airport-after-virus-outbreak (''Bangkok Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****Iran records a record high 235 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours. The health ministry urges not to visit [[Mashhad]] as the virus infections rose by 300 percent over a one month period. [https://english.alarabiya.net/en/coronavirus/2020/07/28/Coronavirus-Iran-sees-record-of-235-COVID-19-deaths-over-past-24-hours.html (Al Arabiya)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****Indonesia reports a record high 2,366 recoveries from COVID-19 in the last 24 hours. [[West Java]] reports a most number with 627 new recoveries. [https://news.detik.com/berita/d-5111289/pecah-rekor-tambah-2366-ini-sebaran-60539-kasus-sembuh-corona-28-juli (detikNews)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****[[Osaka Prefecture|Osaka]] and [[Aichi Prefecture|Aichi]] prefectures post a single day record high of 155 and 110 new COVID-19 cases respectively in the last 24 hours. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2020/07/28/national/tokyo-reports-266-new-coronavirus-cases/#.XyAhqWozbMw (''The Japan Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Belarus]]
****[[President of Belarus|Belarus President]] [[Alexander Lukashenko]] tests positive for [[COVID-19]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/belarus-president-alexander-lukashenko-says-he-had-asymptomatic-coronavirus/a-54359002 (DW)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malta]]
****[[Malta]]'s health ministry states that of 94 migrants rescued from the sea yesterday, 65 have tested positive for COVID-19. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-malta-migrants/malta-says-65-rescued-migrants-test-positive-for-covid-19-idUSKCN24T2GV?il=0 (Reuters)]

;International relations
*[[United States–Zimbabwe relations]]
**Zimbabwe's ruling [[ZANU–PF]] threatens U.S. ambassador [[Brian A. Nichols]] with expulsion and calls him a "thug", accusing him of funding organizers of anti-government protests planned for Friday. The embassy denies the accusations of meddling in local politics and did not comment on the insult. [https://apnews.com/adf94a220f153e1ba8b1163d20a1b5fa (AP)]

;Law and crime
*[[1Malaysia Development Berhad scandal]]
**Former Malaysian [[Prime Minister of Malaysia|Prime Minister]] [[Najib Razak]] is found guilty by the [[Malaysian High Court]] and sentenced to 12 years' imprisonment and fined [[Malaysian ringgit|RM]]210 million ([[United States dollar|US$]]47 million). The High Court convicted Najib on all seven counts of [[abuse of power]], [[money laundering]] and [[Civil wrong|criminal breach of trust]] over misappropriating over RM42 million (US$ 10 million) from 1Malaysia Development Berhad's former subsidiary SRC International to his personal bank accounts. [https://www.malaymail.com/news/malaysia/2020/07/28/high-court-finds-najib-guilty-of-misappropriation-of-rm42m-src-internationa/1888749 (''Malay Mail'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-53563065 (BBC News)] [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/malaysia-najib-razak-1mdb-trial-verdict-guilty-12967036 (Channel News Asia)]
*[[George Floyd protests in Australia]]
**The [[New South Wales Police]] arrests six people, including organizer Paddy Gibson, at a [[Black Lives Matter]] rally in [[Sydney]]; five of those were handed penalty infringement notices. They arrested them because they were breaching a public health order. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2020-07-28/sydney-black-lives-matter-protesters-detained/12498034 (ABC News Australia)]
*[[2020 Nova Scotia attacks]]
**Following massive public backlash, Public Safety Minister [[Bill Blair (politician)|Bill Blair]] announces a [[public inquiry]] will be held over the law enforcement response to the rampage in [[Nova Scotia]], Canada, last April, which left 23 dead, including the gunman. [https://globalnews.ca/news/7224747/nova-scotia-mps-inquiry-mass-shooting/ (Global News)]
*A woman and her brother-in-law are arrested in [[Essen]] and [[Hildesheim]], Germany, respectively, after they travelled to [[Syria]] to join [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]]. The woman also travelled with her four young children. [https://apnews.com/d02d2bcec4e738d7fa528f19ae0cf239 (AP)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Hong Kong]] legal scholar and pro-democracy activist [[Benny Tai]] is fired from his tenured position as [[associate professor]] of law at the [[University of Hong Kong]], due to his prior arrest for coordinating the [[2014 Hong Kong protests|Umbrella Revolution]]. Tai in a [[Facebook]] post called it the "end of academic freedom" in the city. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-hongkong-security/hong-kong-university-sacks-veteran-democracy-activist-idUSKCN24T1VN?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[President of Chile|Chilean President]] [[Sebastián Piñera]] sacks six ministers in his cabinet, including [[Ministry of the Interior and Public Security (Chile)|Interior Minister]] Gonzalo Blumel, as a response to the current political crisis. Last week, a constitutional reform to change the [[Pensions in Chile|pension system]] and increase support for [[COVID-19 pandemic in Chile|COVID-19-affected families]] was approved with cross-party support despite the government's rejection. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-chile-politics/chiles-president-pinera-removes-interior-foreign-defense-ministers-idUSKCN24T2MX?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Science and technology
*Astronomers at [[Pan-STARRS]] announce the discovery of a small [[near-Earth object]] (NEO) HLV2514, which is an [[Amor asteroid]] near [[Mars]]. The asteroid was first discovered in June 2020 by two 14-year-old [[India]]n schoolgirls who were participating in a [[NASA]] project. [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/07/28/india/india-schoolgirl-asteroid-intl-scli-scn/index.html (CNN)]
